about.title: Whittier Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Whittier sits where the San Gabriel Valley meets the Gateway Cities, and its streets carry a steady mix of commuters, students, and neighborhood traffic. In 2025, Los Angeles County public records logged 443 injury collisions inside the city, with 599 people hurt and 7 lives lost. Whittier Boulevard, Lambert Road, Beverly Boulevard, and Painter Avenue account for the largest share of those reports, and Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. show the highest counts. Behind each number is a person trying to figure out what comes next. If that is you, LawProactive can help without charging you anything. We are not a law firm. We listen to what happened, then connect you with an independent California attorney who handles car accident claims on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. California gives you two years to file in most cases, but far less if a city or county vehicle was involved. Getting guidance early keeps your options open while you focus on getting better.

whyChoose.title: Why Whittier Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Partial Fault Doesn't Close the Door
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so you can still pursue a claim even if you were partly responsible; your share of blame simply reduces the recovery rather than erasing it. An attorney can push back when an insurer tries to inflate your percentage.

items.title: Deadlines That Are Easy to Miss
items.desc: Most Whittier car accident claims must be filed within two years, but a crash involving a city bus, county truck, or other government vehicle may require a claim in as little as six months. We connect you quickly so those clocks are tracked from the start.

items.title: Evidence and Statements Handled Carefully
items.desc: Photos, dashcam footage, and witness names fade fast, and the other driver's insurer will likely ask for a recorded statement you are not required to give. The attorneys in our network work on contingency and can take over that communication for you.

items.question: I was hit on Whittier Boulevard during Friday evening traffic. What should I do first?
items.answer: Get medical attention even if you feel mostly fine, since neck and back symptoms often show up a day or two later. Save the police report number, photos of both vehicles, and the names of anyone who stopped to help. Then reach out to us; we will connect you with an independent attorney who can start preserving evidence before it disappears.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company keeps calling for a recorded statement. Do I have to give one?
items.answer: No. You are not obligated to give a recorded statement to another party's insurer, and adjusters are trained to ask questions in ways that can shrink your claim. A polite refusal is fine. Once you are connected with an attorney, they can handle those conversations on your behalf.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service and not a law firm; we simply connect you with an independent California attorney. The attorneys we work with take car accident cases on contingency, which means they are paid only if there is a recovery, and you will discuss those terms directly with them before agreeing to anything.
